conclusion: On 24 complete published routes, window-focused relocation produced 10 nonnegative departure-delay witnesses; the recorded sequences produced 10. 14 routes remained inconclusive under the search budget.

audit.upper_bound: Maximize departure time subject to a one-incoming-arc travel lower bound and shortest depot-to-deadline constraints

next_decision: Offer delay only up to a recomputed feasible route witness. If the search and upper bounds disagree, retain the interval and use more solver time before making a dispatch promise.

study_design.protocol: Select six UUID-ordered high-rated routes of 45–145 stops from each of four depots before inspecting time windows. Evaluate the driver order and two classical route-improvement searches at the same move budget. Use backward time propagation for feasible witnesses and independent relaxation bounds for the largest possible delay. Report a station held out of design and a common zone disruption.
